slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: The objective is to maximize total annual net income. Does this include the earnings from external work (2.1 yuan/person-day in spring/summer, 1.8 yuan/person-day in autumn/winter) as part of the total income to be maximized, or is the objective only the net income from crops and animals?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and clarified whether external work earnings are included in total annual net income.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 objective slot but never entered READY_TO_MODEL or an equivalent final modeling state; instead it repeated the same integer-constraint question many times.

summary: The agent successfully clarified the core objective and many modeling details, but then became stuck in a repetitive loop on the crop integer-labor constraint and never produced a final model or READY_TO_MODEL state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
